visual_events.description: The camera moves slowly backward and pans slightly left along the exterior wall of a completed red-brick building (ent_brick_building). On the main wall face, alternating stretcher and shorter header-like brick faces are visible with recessed mortar joints, along with a diagonal diamond grid of small square ventilation openings and the bottom corner of an upper window opening. At right, a stepped corbelled brick barrel-vaulted canopy (ent_porch_canopy) projects over entrance steps beside a small grey-and-red masonry bench and a circular well or planter structure in the sandy, tree-lined yard. As the camera pulls back between 0.0s and 4.330667s, more of a decorative semicircular archway (ent_bottle_arch) in the lower-left foreground comes into view, revealing green and brown glass bottles embedded radially like spokes around a central hub.
